abstract: Covers the Standard Webhooks specification, line 1.0 (specification text "Version: 1.0.0", pinned at repository tag v1.0.2). References are split into signing and verifying (headers, signed content, v1 HMAC-SHA256 and v1a ed25519, secret formats, rotation, replay protection), delivery (retries, status handling, timeouts, disabling endpoints), payloads and security (structure, event types, thin payloads, SSRF), and versions and migration.
